brief: Calculate the remaining amount for a goal and check whether repeated contributions fit both the deadline and available resources.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Make a saving goal"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Prepara una meta de ahorro"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Prepare uma meta de poupança"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Calculate the remaining amount for a goal and check whether repeated contributions fit both the deadline and available resources.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Give saving a purpose, an amount and a date. These examples use dollars; check whether each plan fits.
instruction.misconception: Dividing the full target instead of the remaining gap, or treating an unaffordable contribution as a workable plan.
instruction.numeracy_support: Subtract current savings from the target, then build the gap using repeated equal contributions.

evidence.reasoning: A repair goal is 100 and 20 is already saved. The missing amount is 100 − 20 = 80.
Four contributions of 20 make 80. This plan works only if each contribution fits and arrives before the repair deadline.
This chart starts from zero for the missing amount only. Try saving 20 weekly for four weeks, then compare 10.
Existing savings reduce the amount still needed.
The contributions cover the missing amount by the stated dates.
Fund the remaining gap, not the full target again.
A correct sum is not enough if its contributions cannot fit.
A flexible deadline can allow more affordable contribution periods.
The contributions fill the remaining gap before enrollment.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.

en-US.line: Give saving a purpose, an amount and a date. These examples use dollars; check whether each plan fits.

es-MX.line: Dale al ahorro un propósito, un monto y una fecha. Explora montos ficticios en pesos y comprueba si el plan cabe.

pt-BR.line: Dê à poupança um propósito, um valor e uma data. Explore valores fictícios em reais e confira se o plano cabe.

en-US.line: A repair goal is 100 and 20 is already saved. The missing amount is 100 − 20 = 80.

es-MX.line: La meta para una reparación es 100 y ya hay 20 ahorrados. Faltan 100 − 20 = 80.

pt-BR.line: A meta para um conserto é 100 e já há 20 poupados. Faltam 100 − 20 = 80.

en-US.line: Four contributions of 20 make 80. This plan works only if each contribution fits and arrives before the repair deadline.

es-MX.line: Cuatro aportaciones de 20 reúnen 80. El plan funciona solo si cada aportación cabe y llega antes de la reparación.

pt-BR.line: Quatro contribuições de 20 reúnem 80. O plano funciona só se cada contribuição couber e chegar antes do conserto.

en-US.prompt: This chart starts from zero for the missing amount only. Try saving 20 weekly for four weeks, then compare 10.

es-MX.prompt: Esta gráfica empieza en cero solo para el faltante. Prueba ahorrar 20 semanales durante cuatro semanas y compara con 10.

pt-BR.prompt: Este gráfico começa em zero só para o valor que falta. Teste poupar 20 por semana durante quatro semanas e compare com 10.

en-US.scene: Your target is 100 and you already have 20 saved for it.
help: Subtract what is already saved from the goal.

feedback.met: Existing savings reduce the amount still needed.
feedback.not_yet: Subtract what is already saved from the goal.

es-MX.scene: Tu meta es 100 y ya tienes 20 ahorrados para ella.
help: Resta a la meta lo que ya tienes ahorrado.

feedback.met: Lo ahorrado reduce el monto que aún falta.
feedback.not_yet: Resta a la meta lo que ya tienes ahorrado.

pt-BR.scene: Sua meta é 100 e você já tem 20 poupados para ela.
help: Subtraia da meta o que já tem poupado.

feedback.met: O que foi poupado reduz o valor que ainda falta.
feedback.not_yet: Subtraia da meta o que já tem poupado.

en-US.prompt: Which plan fills the stated gap?
en-US.scene: You need 80 across four dates. Each contribution is affordable.
help: Add the contributions and compare with the gap.

feedback.met: The contributions cover the missing amount by the stated dates.
feedback.not_yet: Add the contributions and compare with the gap.

es-MX.scene: Aún faltan 80 y hay cuatro fechas para aportar. Cada aportación propuesta cabe en el presupuesto.
help: Suma las aportaciones y compáralas con el faltante.

feedback.met: Las aportaciones cubren el faltante en las fechas indicadas.
feedback.not_yet: Suma las aportaciones y compáralas con el faltante.

pt-BR.prompt: Qual plano cobre a falta informada?

feedback.met: As contribuições cobrem a falta nas datas informadas.
feedback.not_yet: Some as contribuições e compare com o que falta.

en-US.scene: A goal costs 150; 50 is already reserved for it.
help: Keep the existing reserved amount in the calculation.

feedback.met: Fund the remaining gap, not the full target again.
feedback.not_yet: Keep the existing reserved amount in the calculation.

es-MX.scene: Una meta cuesta 150; ya hay 50 apartados para ella.
